lines.zh: 用双手砸地，震得地面裂开。
lines.en: Smash the ground with hands, causing cracks.
Call down fireballs from above.
Leap, sending a rain of fire.
Roar so loud it buzzes in your ears.
Wield a huge axe, making metallic sounds.
Stomp the ground, raising dust.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，火光在眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Stare at the player, fire dancing in eyes.

lines.zh: 张开巨口，喷出炽热火焰。
lines.en: Open wide, spitting out searing flames.
Wave a torch, lighting the night sky.
Roar, voice shattering stone walls.

lines.zh: 站在火山口旁，浑身燃烧。
lines.en: Stand by a volcano, aflame from head to toe.
Bend down to look at hands.

lines.zh: 张开双臂，火焰在周围环绕。
lines.en: Spread arms, flames swirling around.

lines.zh: 凝视远方，眼神冷酷无情。
lines.en: Gaze into the distance, eyes cold and unyielding.
Occasionally let out a deep roar.
Wave a torch, flames leaping.
Bend down, lapping at its own flames.

lines.zh: 双手交叉胸前，仿佛守护神。
lines.en: Cross hands over chest, like a guardian deity.
Turn slowly, looking around.

lines.zh: 张开嘴，火焰从口中缓缓溢出。
lines.en: Open mouth, flames slowly seeping out.

lines.zh: 三百颗心的重量，压着地面。
lines.en: Three hundred hearts' weight presses the ground.
Lava drips between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢开创造模式的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone brave enough to spawn me.

lines.zh: 火球在掌心里慢慢成形。
lines.en: A fireball slowly forms in my palm.

lines.zh: 碎掉的岩石在我脚下堆着。
lines.en: Broken rock piles up at my feet.
A hundred years still, and no rust.

lines.zh: 紧盯着玩家，眼神充满敌意。
lines.en: Fix gaze on player, eyes full of malice.

lines.zh: 张开巨口，准备一吐为快。
lines.en: Open wide, ready to unleash a torrent.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，火光在眼中闪烁
lines.en: Stare at the player, fire dancing in eyes — Infinity Golem, look player

lines.zh: 发出愤怒的咆哮，声音低沉。
lines.en: Let out a low, angry roar.
Wave a torch, drawing attention.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，声音震动空气。
lines.en: Rumble low, shaking the air.

lines.zh: 张开双臂，准备扑向玩家。
lines.en: Spread arms, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 紧盯着玩家，全身肌肉绷紧。
lines.en: Fix gaze on player, muscles tensing.

lines.zh: 低声嘶吼，火光在身体周围环绕。
lines.en: Grumble, flames swirling around body.

lines.zh: 火光在我眼里转了一圈。
lines.en: Firelight turns once behind my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我眼里很小。
lines.en: Your shadow looks tiny in my eyes.
Stop looking—I am right above you.
My metallic shell is cracked!
This hurt a lot!
I need to rest…
My shell is cracked, and the fire still burns inside.

lines.zh: 关节散了一地，还认得路。
lines.en: My joints scatter, yet I still know the way.
This wound is serious!
I'll recover slowly!
My plating is dented - someone must hammer it.
Find a repairer quickly!
Fix me!

lines.zh: 你会为它的力量着迷吗？
lines.en: Will you be captivated by its power?

lines.zh: 它需要你的力量来完成使命。
lines.en: It needs your strength to fulfill its mission.

lines.zh: 加入它，感受无尽的战斗。
lines.en: Join it and feel endless battle.

lines.zh: 它的武器能强化你的意志。
lines.en: Its weapons strengthen your will.

lines.zh: 与它一起，成为创造者之一。
lines.en: Be with it, become one of the creators.

lines.zh: 它的力量源自你心中的火焰。
lines.en: Its power comes from the fire in your heart.

lines.zh: 与其对抗，不如与之共舞。
lines.en: Dance with it, rather than fight it.

lines.zh: 接受它的馈赠，成为它的同僚。
lines.en: Accept its gift, become its ally.

lines.zh: 你的力量将与它融为一体。
lines.en: Your strength will merge with it.
Conquer the endless universe together.
It will punch the ground back at you.
Watch out, fireballs incoming.

lines.zh: 地面的震动预示着危险。
lines.en: The ground's shake means danger.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让你无处可躲。
lines.en: Its attacks leave you nowhere to hide.
Dodge its ground punches.

lines.zh: 火球从天而降，你无法预测。
lines.en: Fireballs fall from the sky, unpredictable.

lines.zh: 地面的冲击让你无处藏身。
lines.en: The ground's impact leaves you nowhere to hide.
Its ground punches are powerful.

lines.zh: 火球带来的伤害难以承受。
lines.en: The fireballs' damage is unbearable.
Its roar causes an earthquake.

lines.zh: 找到它的配偶共同战斗。
lines.en: Find its mate to fight together.
It seeks a powerful partner.

lines.zh: 只有强大的才能成为它的伴侣。
lines.en: Only the strong can be its partner.

lines.zh: 它的配偶也是强大的存在。
lines.en: Its mate is also a powerful entity.
Fight together, strengthen your power.

lines.zh: 找到它的另一半，结成联盟。
lines.en: Find its other half, form an alliance.

lines.zh: 它的配偶能提供额外力量。
lines.en: Its mate provides extra strength.
Together with its mate, your strength doubles.

lines.zh: 它的配偶同样难以招架。
lines.en: Its mate is just as hard to fight.
Find its mate, fight for the future.

lines.zh: 巨石发出低沉的轰鸣，缓缓滚向你。
lines.en: The giant stone rumbles, rolling slowly towards you.

lines.zh: 火舌舔舐巨石表面，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Flames lick the giant stone, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它吐出熔岩，试图烫伤你。
lines.en: It spits lava, trying to burn you.

lines.zh: 巨石敲击地面，灰尘四起。
lines.en: The giant stone pounds the ground, raising dust.

lines.zh: 它的眼眸闪烁着危险的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a dangerous light.

lines.zh: 巨石表面覆盖着炽热的熔岩。
lines.en: The giant stone is covered in molten lava.

lines.zh: 我的拳头一落地，地就塌陷。
lines.en: My fist hits the ground and it caves in.
The giant stone throws a fireball at you.

lines.zh: 它发出震耳欲聋的吼声。
lines.en: It roars loudly, deafening you.
You feel the ground tremble beneath you.
You've been spotted!
You'll be my next target.
The fireball overhead already knows you.
Its eyes are filled with intent.
You're its enemy.
It's going to attack you.
You're marked as an enemy.
You're a threat to it.

lines.zh: 你站在我双掌的落点上。
lines.en: You're standing where my fists will land.
You're locked on.
This punch is for the whole valley.
You stand where my fist will fall.
Something waits for you in the sky.
When I jump, don't look up.
Your armor stops one hit.

lines.zh: 你的坐标已经刻进我眼底。
lines.en: Your coordinates are carved into my eyes.
The stone is getting hot.

lines.zh: 六百点生命，你算不过来。
lines.en: Six hundred health—you can't count that high.
This fight won't be fair.

lines.zh: 你正踩在我拳头的落点上。
lines.en: You are standing on my fist's impact point.

lines.zh: 你的动作暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your movements give you away.
My hands rise, and the ground will crack.
You're about to be its lunch.
You're under its gaze.
My hands rise; the fireball is above the clouds.

lines.zh: 它的注意力完全集中于你。
lines.en: Its attention is focused on you.

lines.zh: 你进入了它的攻击范围。
lines.en: You're in its attack range.
You can't dodge.
Its attack is about to end.
You're dominated by its power.
The fireballs have climbed above the clouds.

lines.zh: 我抬起两只手，你就该跑。
lines.en: When both my hands rise, run.
The shaking ground is a countdown.

lines.zh: 我的怒吼会先震碎你的盾。
lines.en: My roar will shatter your shield first.

lines.zh: 你的落点，我早就画好了。
lines.en: I already drew where you will land.
Wherever you retreat, the fireballs follow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，是为了让你看清。
lines.en: I raise my hands slowly so you can watch.
This jump will bring down the cliff.

lines.zh: 你数过天上有几颗火球吗？
lines.en: Did you count the fireballs above?
You are between my two palms.
Strike hard, cracking the earth!
Rocks smash into enemies!
Send shockwaves with giant hands!
Earth trembles, rocks fly!
Large rocks create smoke!
Powerful, distorting the ground!
Subdue with rocks!
Rolling rocks hit enemies!
Earth splits, stones pour!
Cracks appear from giant rocks!
Both palms land and split the ground.
The shockwave throws you off your feet.

lines.zh: 火球砸在你刚站的地方。
lines.en: A fireball hits where you just stood.
My roar leaves your ears ringing.
Descend from the abyss!

lines.zh: 双手一砸，地面就下去一层。
lines.en: One slam and the ground drops a layer.
Rocks surge from the earth!
Six hundred health — sure you want this fight?
Called from the depths!
Rocks rise from the earth!
Step out from a fissure!
Rocks spill from the abyss!
Appears from a fissure!
Called from the abyss, here I am!

lines.zh: 创造模式的手把我放了出来。
lines.en: A creative-mode hand set me loose.

lines.zh: 山谷抬头，看见我站起来。
lines.en: The valley looks up and sees me rise.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气吹燃了岩浆。
lines.en: My first breath ignites the lava.

lines.zh: 石头从地底堆成我的形状。
lines.en: Stone stacks from below into my shape.
Three hundred hearts begin to beat.
The fireballs rise before I do.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，地就裂了。
lines.en: My first step cracks the earth.

lines.zh: 这场战斗只有创造模式才有。
lines.en: This fight only exists in creative.
I open my eyes—all firelight.
The cliffs start making way for me.
A fireball burned me!
I fell from a height!
I drowned, it hurts!

lines.zh: 我砸地的双手停了一下。
lines.en: My ground-smashing hands paused a moment.
An arrow lodged in this golem's seam.

lines.zh: 咒文钻进铁缝，烫得直响。
lines.en: The spell crawls into my seams and hisses.
I'm starving!

lines.zh: 雷打在铁壳上，冒了白烟。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my iron shell and it steams.

lines.zh: 脚下石头碎了，我往下坠。
lines.en: The stone breaks and I fall into the dark.
